about: The fake agent's own screens (tests/fake_agent.py dialog_on_screen): a dialog asks on a `?? ` row and ends on its keys, `(y/n)`. A screen marked ready is one AgentScreen.ready_on_screen (or its default) reads as ready for a typed line; every other is not. AgentScreen.modal_on_screen (or its default) names each dialog by its words, and no screen without one.

dialogs.what: a dialog whose question scrolled off
